zg361_p3_ag_launch_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_runtime_applied
	zg361_case_ag_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

		zg361_p3_ag_initialize_effect = yes
		var:zg361_case_ag_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_p3_ag_owner }
		save_scope_as = zg361_p3_ag_subject
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_p3_ag_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_p3_ag_case value = var:zg361_case_ag_case_serial }
		if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			zg361_p3_ag_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					root = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode
						var:zg361_p3_player_batch_mode < 4
					}
				}
				zg361_p3_ag_continue_player_effect = yes
			}
			else = {
				scope:zg361_p3_ag_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.301 } }
			}
		}
	}
}
